subject: Aug ops checkpoint — dashboard highlights + QBR prep
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Aug ops checkpoint — dashboard highlights + QBR prep

Hi team,

Attaching this month’s snapshot and a condensed dashboard PDF (attached) — quick read first, deep-dive later: 2026-08 KPI highlights across latency, cost, uptime, and usage. High-level notes: 

- Latency: median p99 for text-gen rose from 320ms -> 410ms the week of Aug 10. Suspected change tied to a new kernel selection on Dedicated nodes.
- Cost: unit cost increased ~8% QoQ; biggest driver is small bursts of unbatched high-concurrency requests from a new partner integration (Acme Cloud).
- Uptime: platform availability slipped from 99.98% -> 99.92% for the same window; three brief incidents (two were marketplace-related).
- Usage: product-led growth spike in EU region; no immediate capacity issue but highlights cross-region routing exposure.

As we prep for the QBR next week, I need three short commitments (can be one-liners):
1) Jonas — can you validate whether the kernel rollout on Dedicated started Aug 9 and share the rollout tag + rollback window?
2) Markus — please confirm if the caching rollout we discussed is scheduled for Sept 2 and whether we can front-load some config changes to blunt the cost impact.
3) Irene — can you pull the incident timelines and the postmortem links for the three availability hits and flag any outstanding runbook gaps?

Attaching: 2026-08-kpi-dashboard.pdf (abridged), latency-samples.csv (sample p99 traces). Also linking the live dashboard here: https://looker.redwood.com/dashboards/ops/monthly-kpi-2026-08

Goal: consolidate one-slide highlights for each metric by Monday EOD so Laura and I can assemble the QBR deck.

Thanks — Soojin

Signature:
Soojin Lee
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 17:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Aug ops checkpoint — dashboard highlights + QBR prep

On Fri, 21 Aug 2026 at 15:12, Soojin Lee wrote:
> Attaching this month’s snapshot and a condensed dashboard PDF (attached) — quick read first, deep-dive later...

Thanks Soojin — quick answers: 
- Kernel rollout: yes, rollout tag v2.11.3 kicked on Aug 9 across a subset of Dedicated pools (pool-ded-2a/2c). We observed slightly higher tail latency on models with long context (>=2k). Rollback window open until Aug 25; I’ll drop the rollout manifest and the kernel perf diff into the shared drive by EOD.
- I’ll also include a short note on whether the kernel selector can be pinned per-model for a short-term mitigation.

Action: I’ll own the latency slide and provide the manifest + perf diff link by Monday 1800 UTC.

—Jonas

Signature:
Jonas Weber
Director, Serving Runtime
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Aug ops checkpoint — dashboard highlights + QBR prep

Thanks for the summary.

I pulled incident timelines:
- 2026-08-11 03:14 UTC: Marketplace auth spike -> 7m partial degradation (Acme Cloud session refresh causing 429 storm). Postmortem draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/pm-2026-08-11
- 2026-08-13 22:40 UTC: Autoscaler misconfiguration in eu-west -> 12m degraded throughput (fixed by hotfix). Postmortem draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/pm-2026-08-13
- 2026-08-14 01:07 UTC: transient KV cache eviction bug -> 5m p99 spike (reverted config). Postmortem draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/pm-2026-08-14

Runbook gaps (summary):
- No clear ownership for marketplace auth bursts; need a protection throttle at ingress for partner integrations.
- Autoscaler SLOs missing a predictable cooldown for EU pools; will add a guardrail.
- Cache eviction alerts are noisy; will refine thresholds and add an automated rehydrate job.

I’ll drop short bullets for the uptime slide and link the PM drafts by Monday morning.

—Irene

Signature:
Irene Choi
VP, Platform Reliability
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:11:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Aug ops checkpoint — dashboard highlights + QBR prep

Quick cost notes:
- Attached CSV has a day-by-day cost delta for Aug (cost-breakdown-aug.csv). Primary driver is inefficient handling of small, single-token requests from the Acme Cloud integration — per-token overhead is high when requests are unbatched.
- Short-term mitigation: enable opportunistic batching and a 10ms queuing window on the edge for partner traffic (can be toggled per-integration). Expected reduction: 5–9% per-token cost for that traffic class.
- Long-term: recommend a quantization profile trial for this partner’s requested models; I’ll coordinate with Applied ML.

I can own the cost slide; will attach the CSV and a 1-slide memo for the QBR.

—Markus

Attachment: cost-breakdown-aug.csv
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Aug ops checkpoint — dashboard highlights + QBR prep

Perfect — thanks all for the fast turn. Consolidated asks and owners below (ready to drop into the QBR deck):

- Latency (slide owner: Jonas) — deliver rollout manifest + perf diff. Deliverable: slide + mitigation options (pin kernel selector) — due Mon 24 Aug 18:00 UTC.
- Uptime (slide owner: Irene) — incident timelines + PM links + runbook gaps (short bullets). Deliverable: slide + 3 runbook fixes to propose — due Mon 24 Aug 12:00 UTC.
- Cost (slide owner: Markus) — day-by-day delta CSV + proposal for opportunistic batching + 1-slide memo. Deliverable: slide + memo — due Mon 24 Aug 12:30 UTC.
- QBR assembly: Laura will assemble slides; Aditya to produce the one-line exec summary.

Next steps: When you post your slide items, add them to the shared doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QBR-Prep-Deck-Redwood-2026-08. I’ll take lead on the QBR narrative and we’ll do a 30m dry run Tuesday morning.

If anything slips, call it out ASAP so we can reassign.

Thanks again — Soojin

Signature:
Soojin Lee
Head of Platform Operations
